## Summary

Created `tests/org/apache/commons/cli2/commandline/WriteableCommandLineImplAgentTest.java`, a self-contained JUnit 3.8 (`junit.framework.TestCase`) suite for `WriteableCommandLineImpl`. Since `Option`/`Group`/`CommandLine` javadoc wasn't in `api/`, the fixture builds real `Option` instances via `DefaultOptionBuilder`/`GroupBuilder` (already compiled into `lib/project.jar`) rather than guessing at the `Option` interface's method list.

Coverage, all grounded in the documented `@param`/`@return` contracts:
- `addOption`/`hasOption`/`getOptions`/`getOption(trigger)`/`getOptionTriggers` — presence before/after add, unknown trigger → `null`, triggers derived dynamically from the real `Option` object (never hardcoded strings).
- `addValue`/`getUndefaultedValues`/`getValues`/`setDefaultValues` — empty-list boundary, per-option isolation, defaults-vs-real-values distinction ("doesn't return values supplied programmatically as defaults").
- `addSwitch`/`getSwitch`/`setDefaultSwitch` — default fallback vs. set/added values.
- `addProperty`/`getProperty`/`getProperties` (both default-set and per-option overloads) — replace-on-add semantics, independence between the default property set and option-scoped ones, and between different options.
- `looksLikeOption`, `toString`, `getNormalised` — boundary/weak-contract cases where javadoc is silent, asserting only what the class's stated non-null-collection convention implies.
